title: Adam Molded, Senses Arrayed, Lifespans Diminished
description: The natural man surveyed in his structure. T56 — how the Lord is intent in his heart upon humanity, how the self catches the divine image and molds its counterfeit, how the Lord comes through that molding rather than to it, for the sake of the soul suffering inside the molded form. T57 — how the senses are set as rooms in the body, with each faculty its own house and storehouse, the heart as king ruling all five, the body as encampment with twelve gates; and how the Mind of Light comes to take the keys. T58 — why what was once borne in fullness comes forth now small and feeble: the order of years has given place to the order of months, days, hours, moments — and what is begotten in each carries the measure of the ordering that rules its season.
